wiki.title: Bruce Tarr
wiki.extract: Bruce E. Tarr (born January 2, 1964) is an American politician and member of the Republican party who serves as the Minority Leader of the Massachusetts Senate. Since 1995 he has represented the 1st Essex and Middlesex District. He is a member of the United States Republican Party and a former member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives.
